India-France Business Groups Sign Luxury Sector MoU in Paris

The Indo-French Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IFCCI) Luxury Committee has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Comite Colbert in Paris. This agreement aims to foster collaboration and development within the luxury sector between the two nations. The signing took place in Paris, marking a significant step for bilateral business ties in the luxury market.
